Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

A flat PostgreSQL array of fixed-size scalars allocated in a memory context and filled in place, as pgrx's
<code>FlatArray</code> is.

```csharp
public sealed class PgFlatArray<T> where T : unmanaged
```

Type parameters:

`T`

The element: sbyte (<code>"char"</code>), short, int, long, uint (<code>oid</code>), float, double or bool.

The storage uses PostgreSQL's native array layout without a NULL bitmap, so every element is present and starts at
zero. It lives until its memory context resets or is deleted. Build arrays with SQL NULL elements with
[PgArray&lt;T&gt;](/api/ankus.pgarray-1/): PostgreSQL does not store NULL elements, so their positions cannot be filled in place.
Return the array from a function through [PgArrayView&lt;T&gt;](/api/ankus.pgarrayview-1/) over [Datum](/api/ankus.pgflatarray-1/#member-f2b477a918704b14).

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

### DangerousGetSpan()

Borrows the elements in row-major order for reading and writing.

```csharp
public Span<T> DangerousGetSpan()
```

Returns: [Span&lt;T&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.span-1)

The native element storage.

Ownership is checked when acquiring the span. Stop using it before the memory context resets or is deleted, the
callback ends or the thread changes.
